original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    otel_collector_version: "0.102.1"
    otel_collector_arch: "amd64"
    otel_collector_platform: "linux"
    otel_collector_download_url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_collector_version }}/otelcol-contrib_{{ otel_collector_version }}_{{ otel_collector_platform }}_{{ otel_collector_arch }}.tar.gz"
    otel_collector_install_dir: "/opt/otelcol-contrib"
    otel_collector_config_dir: "/etc/otelcol-contrib"
    otel_collector_user: "otelcol"
    otel_collector_group: "otelcol"
    otel_collector_service_name: "otelcol-contrib"
    otel_collector_binary: "otelcol-contrib"
    otel_collector_endpoint: "https://your-otel-endpoint.example.com:4317"
    otel_collector_headers:
      "X-API-Key": "your-api-key-here"
    otel_collector_insecure: false
    otel_collector_timeout: "10s"

  tasks:
    - name: Create otelcol user and group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family != "Windows"

    - name: Create otelcol user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        system: yes
        shell: /sbin/nologin
        create_home: no
      when: ansible_os_family != "Windows"

    - name: Create install directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ otel_collector_install_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Create config directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ otel_collector_config_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ otel_collector_download_url }}"
        dest: "/tmp/otelcol-contrib.tar.gz"
        mode: "0644"
        checksum: "sha256:{{ otel_collector_download_url }}.sha256"
      register: download_result
      until: download_result is success
      retries: 3
      delay: 5

    - name: Extract OpenTelemetry Collector
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol-contrib.tar.gz"
        dest: "{{ otel_collector_install_dir }}"
        remote_src: yes
        owner: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        mode: "0755"
        creates: "{{ otel_collector_install_dir }}/{{ otel_collector_binary }}"

    - name: Set binary permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ otel_collector_install_dir }}/{{ otel_collector_binary }}"
        owner: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Create OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: otelcol-config.yaml.j2
        dest: "{{ otel_collector_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        mode: "0644"
      notify: restart otelcol

    - name: Create systemd service file
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: otelcol.service.j2
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ otel_collector_service_name }}.service"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      notify: reload systemd and restart otelcol

    - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ otel_collector_service_name }}"
        enabled: yes
        state: started
        daemon_reload: yes

  handlers:
    - name: restart otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ otel_collector_service_name }}"
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: no

    - name: reload systemd and restart otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ otel_collector_service_name }}"
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: yes
